title: 11-Day Cyclades Cruise & Island Journey
metaDescription: Explore Athens, Mykonos, Naxos, Paros and Santorini on an 11-day Cyclades journey combining island cruising, Aegean scenery and time ashore.

summary:
The 11-Day Greece Cruise Experience combines a mainland circuit with four nights cruising the Aegean, giving the journey two distinct parts. Begin with Athens, Delphi, Meteora and ancient Olympia before boarding the cruise for Mykonos, Kusadasi, Patmos, Crete and Santorini. The sailing portion makes it possible to visit several islands and ports without changing hotels or arranging separate ferry connections each day.
This seasonal journey operates from April to October, with dates linked to the cruise schedule. The program covers selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, a 4-night full-board cruise, English-speaking local guides, transfers and the scheduled sightseeing included in the itinerary.

highlights: Athens • Delphi • Meteora • Olympia • Mykonos • Kusadasi • Patmos • Crete • Santorini

itinerary.title: Tuesday: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Athens.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Wednesday: Athens to Olympia
itinerary.text: Depart from Athens early in the morning. First stop at the famous Corinth Canal, then continue to the ancient Ancient Theatre of Epidaurus, known for its remarkable acoustics. Visit the charming town of Nafplion before exploring Mycenae and the Tomb of Agamemnon. In the afternoon, drive to Olympia via Tripolis and Megalopolis. Overnight in Olympia.

itinerary.title: Thursday: Olympia to Delphi
itinerary.text: In the morning, visit the Archaeological Site of Olympia, including the Sanctuary of Olympian Zeus, Ancient Stadium, and the Archaeological Museum of Olympia. Continue through the plains of Elis and Achaia, crossing the impressive Rio–Antirrio Bridge. Enjoy views of the coastal towns of Nafpaktos and Itea before arriving in Delphi. Overnight in Delphi.

itinerary.title: Friday: Delphi to Meteora
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the Archaeological Site of Delphi, known in ancient times as the center of the world, followed by the Delphi Archaeological Museum to see the famous Bronze Charioteer statue. After the tour, depart for Kalambaka, located at the foot of Meteora. Overnight in Kalambaka.

itinerary.title: Saturday: Meteora to Athens
itinerary.text: Visit Meteora, famous for its monasteries built on towering rock formations. Enjoy breathtaking views and explore the historic monasteries. After the tour, return to Athens via Trikala, Lamia, and Thermopylae, with a short stop at the Leonidas Statue. Continue through the Kamena Vourla area before arriving in Athens in the evening. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Sunday: Half Day Athens Tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a half-day guided tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Acropolis Museum, and Parthenon. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Afternoon at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Monday: Cruise Departure & Mykonos
itinerary.text: Early in the morning, transfer to Port of Piraeus for embarkation on your 4-night Greek Islands cruise. Depart from Athens and sail to Mykonos, famous for its sandy beaches, lively atmosphere, Little Venice, and iconic windmills. Enjoy free time to explore the island. Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: Tuesday: Kusadasi & Patmos
itinerary.text: Arrival at KuKusadasi. Optional excursion to Ephesus, one of the best-preserved ancient cities in the world. Continue cruising to Patmos with an optional visit to the Monastery of Saint John the Theologian and the Cave of the Apocalypse, where St. John wrote the Book of Revelation. Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: Wednesday: Rhodes
itinerary.text: Early morning arrival at Rhodes, known as the Island of Roses. Rhodes offers a unique blend of history, beautiful beaches, lively nightlife, and shopping opportunities. Optional tours are available to visit the Medieval Old Town and the famous Acropolis of Lindos. Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: Thursday: Crete & Santorini
itinerary.text: Arrival at Heraklion in the morning. Optional excursion to the Palace of Knossos, the center of the ancient Minoan Civilization. Continue cruising to Santorini in the afternoon and enjoy stunning views of the island’s whitewashed villages and volcanic cliffs. Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: Friday: Lavrio Port to Athens Airport
itinerary.text:
Early morning arrival at Port of Lavrio.
Disembark from the cruise ship and transfer to the airport for your departure flight. End of services.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 11-Day Greece Cruise Experience?
faqs.a: The 11-Day Greece Cruise Experience covers Athens, Mykonos, Santorini, Naxos, Crete, Rhodes, and Kusadasi. This itinerary combines Greece's most famous islands with a visit to Turkey's Aegean coast, allowing travelers to experience ancient history, island culture, beautiful beaches, and stunning Mediterranean scenery. The tour runs for 10 nights and 11 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 11-Day Greece Cruise Experience cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,495 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, cruise transportation between destinations, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers specified in the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, cabin category, and availability.

faqs.q: Is cruise transportation between the islands included?
faqs.a: Yes, transportation between Athens, Mykonos, Santorini, Naxos, Crete, Rhodes, and Kusadasi is included according to the cruise itinerary. The cruise offers a relaxing and scenic way to explore multiple destinations while enjoying the beauty of the Aegean Sea.

faqs.q: Are international flights included in the package?
faqs.a: No, international flights are not included in the tour price. Travelers are responsible for arranging their own flights to and from Greece. Magnificent Travel can assist with travel planning and recommendations if needed.

faqs.q: Does the 11-Day Greece Cruise Experience include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want a comprehensive introduction to the Greek Islands. It combines famous destinations, ancient history, beautiful coastlines, and a visit to Turkey, creating a diverse and memorable travel experience.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historic towns, island villages, ports, and archaeological sites. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate throughout the itinerary.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Mykonos, Santorini, Naxos, Crete, Rhodes, and Kusadasi?
faqs.a: Mykonos is famous for its lively atmosphere, beaches, and whitewashed streets. Santorini offers spectacular caldera views and iconic sunsets. Naxos is known for its authentic Greek charm and beautiful coastline. Crete features rich history and traditional culture. Rhodes is home to a UNESCO-listed Medieval Old Town, while Kusadasi provides access to the magnificent ancient city of Ephesus.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 11-Day Greece Cruise Experience?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 90 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 90 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, cruise conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 11-Day Greece Cruise Experience available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The cruise operates seasonally according to cruise schedules and weather conditions. You can extend your stay in Athens before or after the cruise, upgrade accommodation, add optional excursions, or customize your travel arrangements. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
